title: Banff’s Must-Do Food Walk Tour: Taste the Rockies in 3 Hours
includes: Stunning mountain and river views along your route
Art & culture walk exploring public art, and Banff’s history
Guided walking tour led by our local, foodie-obsessed Food Tour Motivator
All food costs, taxes, and service fees
5 chef-curated tastings at Banff’s best local eateries
Exclusive VIP behind-the-scenes experiences with chefs, managers and owners
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us on a journey through Banff as we explore the flavors and cultures that make this mountain town world-renowned. This fun & exciting Food Walk Tour adventure includes 5 mouthwatering chef-curated cuisines from The Fat Ox, Magpie’s, Shokun, and Rocky Mountain Chocolate and Sudden Sally. Along the way, you’ll wander the charming streets of Banff, soak in breathtaking views of the Rocky Mountains and Bow River, and capture plenty of Instagram-worthy moments against this stunning alpine backdrop. From delicious bites to unforgettable scenery, this tour is the perfect blend of food, culture, and adventure in the Canadian Rockies.
